To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the usability of mobile services can be evaluated by using the methodology described in this paper, that the usability of the different mobile services is very different, and that the usability of WAP and iMode services is very poor.
(1) the usability of mobile services is highly dependent of the user interface, and (2) WAP and i-Mode user interfaces are the worst performers in terms of usability.
(1) The user interfaces of mobile services are very different, and this is the reason why they have very different usability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the usability of user interfaces in mobile services.
the usability evaluation of mobile services.
the development of a methodology for evaluating the usability of mobile user interfaces and its application to the services of a major telecommunications operator.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
WAP and iMode UIs should be redesigned to improve their usability, while voice, SMS and web UIs should be maintained as they are.
WAP and i-Mode services are not suitable for a large number of users, while the SMS and web UIs are much more usable.
, for the set of services that were analysed, the web UI was the best performing, followed closely by SMS and the voice UI, while WAP and iMode were the worst performing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the usability of a mobile service is a function of the usability of its user interface, and that usability of a mobile UI is a function of its interaction style.
the usability of mobile services is a complex issue, which requires a detailed analysis and a thorough methodology to evaluate the different aspects that are involved.
the usability measure we present can be used to evaluate any mobile service, regardless of the type of UI.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the usability of the UI of a service has a significant effect on users perception of the overall quality of the service.
usability can be measured and that there are significant differences in the usability of the UIs of different mobile services.
, in the particular case of mobile services, the user interface plays a crucial role in determining the user experience and, therefore, the usability of the service itself.
